title: Beca de Doctorado Nacional Año Académico 2027
institution: Agencia Nacional de Investigación y Desarrollo (ANID)
about: ANID's national doctoral scholarship funds PhD study in accredited programmes at Chilean universities, in all fields, for up to four years. Chilean and foreign applicants may apply; up to 1,000 scholarships. Applications and recommendation letters close 27 November 2026, 13:00 Chile time.
requirements: Licenciatura, professional title or equivalent (including degrees from abroad)
Admitted, formally applying, or enrolled in an accredited doctoral programme at a Chilean university by the close of applications
Academic excellence: graduation average of 5.0/7.0 or above, or top 30% of the graduating ranking
Open to Chilean and foreign nationals, with or without permanent residence

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Admitted, formally applying, or enrolled in an accredited doctoral programme" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."
"Academic excellence" → "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."
